missing_accessible_label.description: Interactive or meaningful component does not expose sufficient accessible labeling.

possible_mutations.description: Remove the Semantics wrapper or accessible label from an interactive or meaningful component.
Replace a meaningful accessible label with an empty or unavailable value.

incorrect_accessible_label.description: Accessible label exists but does not correctly communicate the purpose of the component.

possible_mutations.description: Replace a correct accessible label with an inaccurate or misleading label.

missing_role.description: Custom component does not expose a sufficient semantic role.

possible_mutations.description: Remove the semantic role from a custom interactive component.

missing_state.description: Relevant component state is not exposed through semantics.

possible_mutations.description: Remove a state value such as selected, checked, expanded, or enabled from semantics.

inaccessible_custom_control.description: Custom interactive component does not provide equivalent semantic information.

possible_mutations.description: Remove the semantic information required to operate or understand a custom control.

insufficient_target_size.description: Interactive target provides insufficient area for interaction according to the adopted guideline.

possible_mutations.description: Reduce the interactive hit area below the adopted accessible target size.
Remove the layout or constraint that guarantees the minimum interactive target size.

inaccessible_custom_gesture.description: Custom gesture interaction does not provide an accessible equivalent.

possible_mutations.description: Remove the accessible alternative for a custom gesture interaction.

interaction_not_exposed.description: Interactive behavior is not sufficiently exposed to accessibility mechanisms.

possible_mutations.description: Remove the semantics, callback, or control exposure needed to discover the interaction.
